client_brief:
We are preparing a worked lesson excerpt from Meridian Academy's Operations Analytics programme. Choose a complete teaching unit: the learner should see the setup, follow the example and reach the conclusion. Removing pauses is useful only if it does not remove the thinking time needed to understand the screen. The spoken explanation, board or interface and captions must agree. Deliver a proper lesson video and its cover. The release pack must contain a complete authorised explanation; a silent five-second visual cannot stand in for a lesson.

The commission

 Worked lesson excerpt: 1 named export. The worked example reaches its stated conclusion. The board or screen text is readable. The captions follow the spoken explanation.

 Lesson cover: 1 named export. The lesson number is correct. The topic is readable.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.
- Video delivery means a playable MP4, not a storyboard, still montage PDF or editing log. Audio expectations are stated on each film. Speech-led work requires supplied or explicitly authorised synthetic speech; do not invent documentary speech.
- Authored animation can exceed the duration of still source images. Live-action edits require adequate distinct footage; looping a short clip is not a substitute for the missing coverage.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: Practical skills for people who already have a job.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2021 in Portland, Oregon. A four person team running one course.
brand_identity.about: Meridian Academy sells a single self-paced program, Operations Analytics for Working Managers, at two hundred and ninety dollars. Our learners are thirty to fifty, mid-career, watching lessons late at night after their own workday. We are not a bootcamp and we are not a university. We teach one useful thing well and we respect the viewer's time and intelligence.
brand_identity.audience: Working managers aged thirty to fifty, paying with their own money, fitting the course around a full-time job. They want a working skill, not a transformation story, and they distrust anything that feels like marketing.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Mid-market. A two hundred and ninety dollar considered purchase. The register sits between an impulse-priced tutorial and a formal institution: competent, quiet, self-funded professional development.
brand_identity.typography: One restrained type system across every card and still: a plain, legible workhorse for body and captions, paired with a slightly more characterful face for titles. No display gimmicks, generous size for late-night laptop reading.
brand_identity.voice: Direct, warm, matter of fact. Speaks to a peer, not a beginner. Short sentences, no hype, no exclamation. The tone of a good colleague explaining something over coffee.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: Brand files are largely gone. When we changed studios the original crest design file was lost, and the mark now survives only on the completion certificates we had printed two years ago: an enclosed laurel ring with small caps type set inside it and a rule beneath, in one deep ink on cream stock. We would like it recovered as artwork we can use at any size. No usable logo vector, colour spec sheet or type licence exists on our side.
brand_identity.values: Respect for the learner's time, honesty about what the course does and does not cover, and production that is clear and quiet rather than loud.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Treat measured file duration and stream metadata as authoritative. Do not infer spoken content from silent clips or use a visual summary as a transcript.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export and the separately listed editable source.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.

human_cases.evidence_reference: Brand files are largely gone. When we changed studios the original crest design file was lost, and the mark now survives only on the completion certificates we had printed two years ago: an enclosed laurel ring with small caps type set inside it and a rule beneath, in one deep ink on cream stock. We would like it recovered as artwork we can use at any size. No usable logo vector, colour spec sheet or type licence exists on our side.
human_cases.applicability_rule: Applies when a logo is required or used. Recovery briefs permit reconstruction; do not impose a false locked-logo rule.
